sermon.title: Idols
sermon.speaker: Guest speaker (unnamed)
sermon.summary: A Vine Cluster Church message on idols in the Old Testament, the New Testament and today. God commanded no other gods; Elijah faced Baal’s prophets and fire fell. Paul was called Hermes at Lystra, then stoned, and told Athens that God commands all people to repent. Today we idolize scientists, athletes and ourselves, yet technology can’t solve the moral problems families face.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: the golden calf said to come before the command against other gods (Exodus 32 follows Exodus 20); quotes attributed to Bill Nye and Lawrence Krauss and the “fifty percent not intelligent” remark are unverified; the RNASA gala details; repeated abortion and abuse figures (unverified). Sensitive: “satanic worshippers want you to kill a baby” (9:50). Private names (a congregant and the speaker’s child) appear only in the transcript.

faqs.question: What does Jesus do with sin?
faqs.answer: He nails it to the cross and gives power to live right.

faqs.question: Can an idol see or hear?
faqs.answer: No—it is metal or wood with no breath.

faqs.question: Who brings trouble on a nation?
faqs.answer: Those who forsake the commandments of the Lord.

faqs.question: Does God want us to cut or harm ourselves?
faqs.answer: No—God is not out to harm you.

faqs.question: Do you need special tools to worship God?
faqs.answer: No—you can worship with your mouth, hands and posture anywhere.

faqs.question: Why did Elijah soak the sacrifice?
faqs.answer: So the fire would be unmistakably God’s.

faqs.question: Does God always do a miracle when we preach?
faqs.answer: No—Paul still preached and moved on.

faqs.question: How can those who don’t preach help?
faqs.answer: Gather around those who preach the word and help them.

faqs.question: Do Christians refuse to explore?
faqs.answer: No—that claim isn’t true; God gives the wisdom.

faqs.question: Does technology solve moral problems?
faqs.answer: No—it doesn’t solve the moral issues families face.
